propositions: uv's universal resolution locks all extras jointly, causing pydantic-ai-slim to downgrade to 1.38.0 when [eval] (via inspect-ai/aiobotocore) pins boto3<1.40.62 while [bedrock]/[dev] require boto3>=1.42.63

pydantic-ai-slim 1.38.0 + anthropic 0.120.2 causes AnthropicModel import to fail because pydantic_ai.models.anthropic expects UserLocation from anthropic.types.beta.beta_web_search_tool_20250305_param which was renamed in newer anthropic
declaring [tool.uv] conflicts between [eval] and [bedrock]/[dev] extras resolves the conflict and permits pydantic-ai-slim>=1.107.1 + anthropic 0.120.2
pip is unaffected because it resolves extras independently; only uv-provisioned environments experience the downgrade
a committed uv.lock with locked install paths (uv sync --locked in Makefile, CI workflows, and container builds) ensures reproducible environments
import smoke test asserting from pydantic_ai.models.anthropic import AnthropicModel must pass in CI to prevent regression
